title: PontoBR Sistemas
description: Founded in 2008 in Brazil, PontoBR Sistemas is an IT firm specializing in advanced call center technologies, including its proprietary Discador Tabulare, as well as public examination management systems. The company provides tailored software solutions and IT infrastructure services, having received recognition from the Brazilian federal innovation agency, FINEP.-SQL Data https://pontobrsistemas.com.br/
